title: de.hubtask.work.item.due_changed.v1
description: An entry's due date moved: set, moved to another moment, or cleared. Single-value enums stand in for `const`, and the bounds of a value are stated in its description rather than as keywords: the contract test validates against this file with the subset of JSON Schema the project implements, and a keyword it silently ignored would be a promise nobody checks. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON (ADR-0007); the tenant, the actor and the causal chain travel as CloudEvents extension attributes, whose names are lower case without separators as the specification requires. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases (domain-model.md §4).

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

source.description: The installation and the bounded context that produced the event.

subject.description: What the event is about, so that a consumer can filter without parsing the payload.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react (ADR-0018).

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP (automation.md §2).

data.description: Both sides of the move rather than a snapshot, which is what the scheduler and the calendar feed react to (domain-model.md §4): a relative reminder follows new_due_at, and a consumer that only saw the new value could not tell a set from a move. The zone travels beside the instants, never folded into them - an all-day due date is a date in this zone, not a midnight that shifts with the viewer (i18n-l10n.md §4).

collection_id.description: The collection the entry belongs to, and the one an actor's permission to see it is judged against.

old_due_at.description: RFC 3339 in UTC (i18n-l10n.md §7). Absent when the due date was just set - there was no old one.

new_due_at.description: RFC 3339 in UTC. Absent when the due date was cleared.

due_date_only.description: True for an all-day due date: new_due_at is read as a date in time_zone, never as an instant. Absent when the due date was cleared.

time_zone.description: The IANA zone the due date is local to, present when one was stored (i18n-l10n.md §7). Absent when the due date was cleared, or when none was given.
